name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: "Classic Margherita Pizza, wood-fired and charred, topped with tomato sauce, melted mozzarella cheese, and fresh basil leaves, presented on a wooden board with a side of marinara sauce and olive oil."

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: "Chicken Tikka Masala served in a copper bowl with handles, garnished with fresh cilantro and accompanied by a side of basmati rice and naan bread. The dish features grilled chicken pieces in a rich, creamy tomato sauce. The meal is presented on a slate plate atop a wooden table."

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: "Vegetable stir-fry with tofu, featuring broccoli, carrots, and snap peas, served in a white bowl with a side of white rice. The dish is cooked in a savory brown sauce and presented in a generous portion. The stir-fry is neatly arranged in the bowl, accompanied by chopsticks to the right."

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: "Fresh Greek salad in a white bowl, featuring lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, Kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese, with a silver serving spoon. A small glass bowl of dressing and a lemon wedge are visible on the side. The salad is presented on a wooden table with a blue and white striped napkin."

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: "Spaghetti Aglio e Olio is presented in a white bowl, topped with grated Parmesan cheese and parsley. The dish features sautéed garlic and red pepper flakes mixed with cooked spaghetti. Steam rises from the pasta, indicating it is freshly prepared. The portion is generously sized."

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: "Glazed salmon fillet on a wooden board, garnished with dill and mustard seeds, served with lemon wedges and a side of glaze sauce. The salmon is cooked and cut into portions, with a fork resting on top. The dish is presented on a wooden cutting board with a dark background."

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: "Chickpea Falafel with Tahini is presented on a plate with six crispy, golden-brown falafel patties, garnished with parsley and served with sliced red onion, lemon, and green beans. The dish is accompanied by a bowl of creamy tahini sauce and various ingredients, including chickpeas and spices. The falafel appears to be pan-fried, with visible seasonings and herbs."

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: "Four beef tacos are arranged on a plate, each containing seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, salsa, guacamole, and sour cream. The tacos are served in crispy tortilla shells and garnished with diced tomatoes. The dish is presented on a dark-colored plate with a rustic, casual setting."

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: "Pan-seared ribeye steak served in a cast-iron skillet with thyme and butter, seasoned with peppercorns and salt. The steak is cooked to a medium-rare and sliced into thick strips. The skillet is surrounded by additional seasonings and ingredients, including coarse salt and peppercorns in small bowls. The dish is presented on a dark surface."

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: "Brown lentils are cooked in a rich, reddish-brown sauce and served in a ceramic bowl. The dish is garnished with cilantro, onions, halved cherry tomatoes, and a slice of lime, and is accompanied by a spoon on a cloth napkin. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients, including turmeric powder, garlic, and an onion."

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: "Pan-seared cod fillet served on a bed of sesame rice, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, and drizzled with a savory sauce. The dish is presented in a ceramic bowl on a blue napkin, accompanied by chopsticks and a spoon. Additional condiments and sesame seeds are arranged on the side."

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: "Roasted tomato and basil pasta dish, featuring penne pasta tossed with roasted cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and grated Parmesan cheese, served on a ceramic plate. The ingredients are arranged artfully, with visible seasoning and a generous portion. The dish is presented on a rustic table surrounded by additional ingredients."

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: "Paneer Butter Masala in a blue-rimmed bowl, garnished with onions and herbs, served with naan bread and basmati rice. The dish features paneer cubes in a rich, red sauce. Visible accompaniments include naan bread, basmati rice, and various spices."

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: "Two glasses of Falooda, a dessert drink, are presented on a grey stone slab, garnished with whipped cream, cherries, and rose petals. The glasses contain layered ingredients including vermicelli noodles, jelly, and milk. The surrounding bowls contain additional toppings such as pink and red powder, noodles, and cherries."

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: "Shakshuka dish in a cast-iron pan, featuring eggs poached in a spicy tomato sauce with peppers and onions, garnished with herbs and peppercorns. The pan is surrounded by various ingredients and spices, including chili peppers, garlic, and paprika. The dish is presented on a gray surface, with a spoon resting in the pan. Ingredients are artfully arranged around the pan."

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: "Black beans and rice are presented on a white plate, garnished with garlic slices and green leaves. The dish is prepared with cooked black beans and white rice, and the beans appear to be cooked with oil and spices. The image shows a step-by-step guide to preparing the dish, highlighting key ingredients such as chopped garlic and a spice mix."

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: "Beef Bulgogi is presented on a large gray plate, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. The dish features thinly sliced grilled beef, cooked to medium-rare, and is surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings, including rice, garlic, and spices."

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: "Spanish Paella Valenciana served in a large, shallow pan with handles, featuring chicken, tomatoes, onions, and rosemary on a bed of yellow rice. The dish is garnished with red peppers and presented on a wooden table surrounded by ingredients. The pan is filled with a savory mixture of cooked chicken, vegetables, and rice, showcasing a traditional cooking style. The image highlights the key ingredients and cooking method used in this classic Spanish recipe."

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: "Grilled chicken breast sliced and served on a bed of romaine lettuce, croutons, and cherry tomatoes, topped with shaved parmesan cheese and a creamy dressing. The dish is presented in a dark-colored bowl, garnished with additional parmesan cheese shavings. The chicken appears to be cooked with grill marks and seasoned with black pepper."

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: "Moussaka in a metal baking pan, featuring layered eggplant, ground meat, and melted cheese. The dish is garnished with fresh herbs and presented on a wooden surface surrounded by ingredients and spices. The cooking style is baked, and the portion appears to be for multiple servings."

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: "Shoyu Ramen served in a dark brown bowl with a rich, light-brown broth, topped with sliced chicken, green onions, black and white sesame seeds, and two halves of a soft-boiled egg. The noodles are visible beneath the toppings. The dish is garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds."

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: "Tagliatelle pasta is served with sautéed shrimp, asparagus, and lemon slices, garnished with herbs. The overall presentation is casual yet appetizing."

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: "Ratatouille presented in a white bowl, featuring sliced zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, and red peppers, garnished with fresh herbs. The dish is surrounded by whole vegetables and spices, including a red bell pepper, onions, and peppercorns. The ingredients are arranged on a wooden cutting board with a fork and spoon. The overall presentation is colorful and vibrant."

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: "Pan-seared salmon fillets with crispy skin, served on a ceramic plate with a side of dill yogurt sauce, garnished with fresh dill and lemon wedges. The dish is presented on a rustic wooden table with a beige napkin and utensils. The salmon is seasoned with pepper and herbs."

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: "Thai Green Curry with Vegetables and tofu, served with white rice in a ceramic bowl. The curry contains a variety of vegetables, including zucchini, bell peppers, and snow peas. The dish is garnished with fresh basil leaves and presented with chopsticks and a spoon."

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: "Mango Sticky Rice is presented on a blue plate, featuring a bowl of sticky rice topped with mango chunks and a green leafy garnish. The dish is accompanied by a halved mango and a wooden spoon with salt. The ingredients are arranged artfully, with a recipe card visible in the background."

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: {"caption": "A quinoa salad is presented in a white bowl, featuring cooked quinoa mixed with sliced cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, and parsley. The salad is garnished with herbs and surrounded by lemon wedges, a bowl of olive oil, and a fork on a dark gray surface."}

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: "Beef shawarma wrap presented in a pita bread, filled with sliced beef, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, and lettuce. The beef appears to be cooked and sliced into thin strips. The wrap is neatly wrapped and tied with twine."

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: "Baked chicken breasts and pasta are presented in a ceramic baking dish. The dish contains four seared chicken breasts on a bed of noodles, topped with melted cheese and a green pesto sauce, accompanied by roasted cherry tomatoes."

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: "Baked eggplant parmesan in a rectangular baking dish, layered with tomato sauce, breaded eggplant slices, and shredded cheese. The dish is presented on a wooden board, surrounded by ingredients such as tomatoes, onions, and grated cheese. The eggplant is breaded and baked with melted cheese on top."

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: "Moroccan Chickpea Stew is served in a decorative ceramic bowl, garnished with fresh cilantro and diced tomatoes. The stew contains chickpeas in a reddish-brown broth, indicating a slow-cooked preparation method. The bowl is placed on a wooden surface, surrounded by ingredients and cooking essentials."

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: "Crunchy Cabbage Slaw is presented in a blue ceramic bowl, showcasing shredded green cabbage and carrots mixed with black sesame seeds. The dish is surrounded by its ingredients, including shredded carrots, mayonnaise, and various seasonings. The ingredients appear to be raw or lightly dressed, indicating a cold preparation method."

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: "Fresh fish ceviche served in a ceramic bowl, garnished with sliced red chili peppers, red onion, cilantro, and a lime wedge. The dish is presented on a wooden cutting board surrounded by additional ingredients."

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: {"caption": "Thai Basil Chicken served with steamed rice on a decorative plate. The dish features stir-fried chicken, Thai basil, and red chilies in a savory sauce. The ingredients are arranged artfully, with a garnish of fresh basil leaves."}

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: "Garlic butter shrimp served in a black pan, garnished with parsley and garlic. The dish is presented on a wooden tray with lemon wedges, garlic bulbs, and small bowls of sauce. The shrimp are cooked in a yellow garlic butter sauce."

directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.

directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: "Gyro wrap filled with grilled meat, sliced tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, and tzatziki sauce, wrapped in a toasted pita bread. The wrap is placed on a wooden board, garnished with herbs. Visible ingredients include meat, vegetables, and sauce. Presented on parchment paper."

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: "Pollo a la Brasa, a Peruvian-style roast chicken, is presented on a clay platter, garnished with lime slices and spices. The dish is surrounded by additional lime slices, garlic cloves, and spices, adding to its vibrant presentation."

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.

directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.

directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.

directions: Mix batter with cabbage.

Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
